{
  "name": "second-opinion",
  "version": "0.7.2",
  "description": "QA check Claude's work with OpenAI, Gemini or xAI models: /second-opinion, /reviewer to pick models and effort, and an ask_model tool Claude can call.",
  "author": {
    "name": "revilo-digital",
    "url": "https://github.com/revilo-digital"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/revilo-digital/second-opinion",
  "repository": "https://github.com/revilo-digital/second-opinion",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "review",
    "qa",
    "openai",
    "gemini",
    "grok",
    "second-opinion"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "openaiApiKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OpenAI API key",
      "description": "Used when OPENAI_API_KEY is not set in the environment.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "geminiApiKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Gemini API key",
      "description": "Used when GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY is not set in the environment.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "xaiApiKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "xAI API key",
      "description": "Used when XAI_API_KEY is not set in the environment.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    }
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
